pattern: Defensive Lift v5.3 Loss-Cluster State Machine
goal: preserve 50% position size and v3.2 upside while blocking only a second slot during evidence-based loss-cluster states

state_machine.GREEN: normal; first and second 50% slots allowed
state_machine.AMBER: entered after a realized losing trade for a limited number of sessions
state_machine.RED: entered after a second loss inside cluster window, or AMBER plus weak market/open-position pain
state_machine.risk_action: never resize or force-exit an existing trade; first 50% slot is always allowed; only the second 50% slot may be blocked
